violations.title: Images do not have alternative text
violations.description: Images need alternative text so users who cannot see the image can understand its purpose.

violations.title: Background and foreground colors do not have enough contrast
violations.description: Some text may be difficult to read because there is not enough contrast between the text and its background.

violations.title: Links do not have discernible names
violations.description: Links should have meaningful text so users can understand where they will go.

violations.title: Form elements do not have associated labels
violations.description: Form controls should have labels so users understand what information they need to enter.

violations.title: Buttons do not have accessible names
violations.description: Buttons should have a clear accessible name describing their purpose.

violations.title: Heading levels should only increase by one
violations.description: Headings should follow a logical order to make the page easier to navigate.

violations.title: The HTML element does not have a lang attribute
violations.description: The page should specify its primary language so assistive technologies can interpret the content correctly.
